meta.title: Liquid effluent to sewer — NUREG/CR-5814 Scenarios No. 1 (sewer inspector) and No. 2 (STP sludge process operator)
meta.description: Screening doses to two workers who are members of the public with respect to the licensee: (1) a sewer system inspector exposed to the facility's wastewater in the interceptor — external immersion in a water slab at 1 m plus inhalation of aerosol; (2) a sewage-treatment-plant (EDAR) operator of sludge dewatering equipment — external exposure to dewatered sludge plus inhalation of resuspended dry sludge. Scenario 1 reproduces the workbook 'Efluentes - Dosis precisas escenarios 1_2_4 v2.xlsx' (sheet Escenario-1); Scenario 2 reproduces IRA-xxxx_Lu-177_dosis_en_escenario2_v1.xlsx (sheet Escenario-2). Screening philosophy of IAEA SRS-19 §4.9 and §6.6.
meta.units_note: Values in this file are in the display units stated in each 'unit' field; the CALC functions work in SI and EFFLUENT.evaluate converts.

breathing_rate_m3_h.label: Breathing rate (light work)
breathing_rate_m3_h.source: ICRP light-work breathing rate (workbook cell D38).

dose_criterion_mSv_y.label: Dose criterion for comparison
dose_criterion_mSv_y.source: User-defined. Workbook default (cell D60). No regulatory basis is attributed by the app.

water_volume_m3_y.label: Water discharged by the facility
water_volume_m3_y.source: Site-specific: obtain from the licensee (consumption ≈ discharge in a hospital). Workbook generic values (cell D20): hospital 20 000 m³/y, clinic 3650 m³/y.

water_density_kg_m3.label: Water density
water_density_kg_m3.source: Mass basis for the aerosol resuspension model (workbook cell D21).

t_inhalation_h_y.label: Inhalation exposure time
t_inhalation_h_y.source: NUREG/CR-5814 §5.2.1 (20 h/y; respirator worn most of the time).

geometry_factor.label: Geometry factor on external dose
geometry_factor.source: Workbook cell D37 (water slab at 1 m, no correction).

transit_h.label: Decay time from discharge to the inspector
transit_h.source: NUREG/CR-5814 §5.2.1 (≈ 0.2 h). Workbook cell D42: 0.008333 d.

catchment_pct.label: Patients living in the STP catchment

wet_sludge_t_per_y.label: Wet (dewatered) sludge production
wet_sludge_t_per_y.source: Site-specific: PRTR-España (prtr-es.miteco.gob.es), waste code LER 19 08 05. Workbook default: STP PRTR code 7504.

dust_loading_kg_m3.label: Dust loading in air
dust_loading_kg_m3.source: NUREG/CR-5814 §5.2.2 (1.0E-4 g/m³); range 5E-8 – 5E-6 kg/m³. Same value in IAEA SRS-19 §6.6.2.

sludge_fraction.label: Fraction of discharged activity retained in sludge
sludge_fraction.source: NUREG/CR-5814 §5.1 and IAEA SRS-19 §4.9 case (b): all activity to sludge (conservative screening assumption).

geometry_factor.label: Geometry / shielding factor on external dose
geometry_factor.source: Workbook cell D41 (no credit for structures).

transit_d.label: Decay time from discharge to sludge press

facility_presets.source: Workbook 'Efluentes - Dosis precisas escenarios 1_2_4 v2.xlsx', sheet Escenario-1, cell D20. Generic values; use the licensee's figure when available.

L10.label: Small sludge mass, up to 100 m² (10 × 10 × 3 m pool)
L10.note: Covers sludge press / hopper (3–6 m, NUREG/CR-5814 §5.2.2), 100 m² biosolids pile (ISCORS 2004-03 §4.7.3) and drying beds 3.0–3.7 m wide (NUREG/CR-6289).

L45.label: General sludge mass, up to 2000 m² (45 × 45 × 3 m pool)
L45.note: Default. Covers real Spanish STP sludge elements (largest found: 616 m², EDAR Sur de Madrid).

geometries.infinite_slab_warning: NUREG/CR-5814 prescribes an infinite slab; no released coefficient covers it. For Lu-177 the PHITS study measured that the 45 × 45 m coefficient captures 73–75 % of the infinite slab (10 × 10 m: ≈ 51 %). No equivalent measurement exists for I-131.

scenario1_geometry.label: Water slab 600 × 200 × 50 cm (6 m³), receptor 1 m above the centre of its surface
scenario1_geometry.note: NUREG/CR-5814 §5.2.1 and Table A.20. The coefficients are photon-only: bremsstrahlung from beta and positron emission is not included and has not been bounded for this geometry (the CSDA range in air of a 0.5 MeV electron exceeds the 1 m distance). The limitation is more severe for F-18 and I-131 than for Lu-177, and least for Tc-99m.

s1.source: Own PHITS 3.33 calculation: 'Escenario 1 del NUREG/CR-5814 · Lu-177, Lu-177m, Tc-99m, I-131 y F-18', 2026-08-20, Table 7. Effective dose rate per unit activity concentration, ROT geometry, ICRP 116 (with ICRP 129 corrigenda); photon transport only. Uncertainty: Monte Carlo statistical, k = 1.

s2.quantity: Effective dose rate per unit activity concentration, ROT geometry, ICRP 116 (with ICRP 129 corrigenda); receptor 2 m above the centre of a uniform 3 m deep source of water-equivalent sludge (1.2 g/cm³).
s2.source: Own PHITS calculation: 'Coeficientes de tasa de dosis efectiva externa para Lu-177 y Lu-177m en el escenario 2 de NUREG/CR-5814', approved 2026-07-30, §7.2. Uncertainties are Monte Carlo standard uncertainties (k = 1). The report does not state a one-sided secondary-electron envelope.

e_inh.source: ICRP Publication 119 (2012), Table G.1, adult member of the public, absorption type M (Lu-177 is tabulated for types M and S only). Same value as RD 783/2001 Annex III table b), repealed by RD 1029/2022 but kept for members of the public by CSN Resolution of 3 April 2024.

s2.quantity: Effective dose rate per unit activity concentration, ROT geometry, ICRP 116 (with ICRP 129 corrigenda); receptor 2 m above the centre of a uniform 3 m deep source of water-equivalent sludge (1.2 g/cm³). Xe-131m excluded (open pool).
s2.source: Own PHITS 3.330 calculation: 'Informe de resultados del I-131 en el escenario 2 de NUREG/CR-5814', INF-I131-S2-RESULTADOS-1.1.0, 2026-08-23. Uncertainties are Monte Carlo standard uncertainties (k = 1); the envelope is a separate one-sided model bound for bremsstrahlung and direct beta, not added to the central value.

e_inh.source: ICRP Publication 119 (2012), Table G.1, adult member of the public, absorption type F (types M and S give 2.4E-9 and 1.6E-9 Sv/Bq; F is the most conservative and the type used by IAEA SRS-19 Table XVI).

source_term.source: Workbook I-131 estimate (cells G6, G56): patients leave hospital with 0.8 GBq and excrete half of it at home. Always one treatment per patient. Site-specific.

nureg_table_B7.note: NUREG/CR-5814 Table B.7: I-131, 3 d decay, 3.9E-2 rem/y for 1 Ci/y (≈ 10.5 µSv/GBq), external dose from the GENII-1990 'STP WKR' factor (effective dose equivalent, ICRP 26/30 era) for a 1 m deep infinite slab at 2 m. Rescaled to the user plant by dry sludge mass and solids fraction.

srs19_table_I_IV.note: IAEA SRS-19 (2001) Table I–IV: 400 t/y dry sludge, no transit decay, 2000 h/y. Annex I uses an occupancy of 0.288 where 2000/8760 = 0.228, so the factor may be 26 % high. Indicative only.

nureg_table_A21_note: NUREG/CR-5814 Table A.21 (pp. A.54–A.56), 'Modified external dose factors for GENII, Sv/yr per Bq/m3 (8-Aug-90)': column 'SEWER MAINT 1.0 m' (Scenario 1) and 'STP WKR 0.15 m' (Scenario 2). Converted with 1 y = 8766 h, the convention that reproduces Table B.7. GENII-1990 effective dose equivalent (ICRP 26/30 era) and NUREG geometries (Table A.20); Lu-177 and Lu-177m are not tabulated. Indicative comparison only; the differences have not been investigated.
